synthesis_method: Each one-shot starts at phase zero. Integer sample-index phase, original quarter-sine Q31 table, ties-even interpolation and gain; float32 only at PCM output.

No physiological event mapper, alarm policy, director, mixer, native backend, device qualification or audio scoring is implemented.
